title: S&P 500’s War Pattern: The Wipeout Begins Every Thursday
title_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数的战争模式：每周四都会出现惨败
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Five weeks into a Middle East war that’s sending shockwaves through the global economy, the US stock market has settled into a predictable pattern.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——中东战争给全球经济带来冲击，五周后，美国股市已经进入了可预测的模式。

title: Globalstar Rallies on Report That Amazon Is in Buyout Talks
title_zh: 有报道称亚马逊正在进行收购谈判，Globalstar 股价上涨
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Globalstar Inc. shares jumped more than 20% in late trading on a Financial Times report that Amazon.com Inc. is in talks to acquire the satellite provider.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——英国《金融时报》报道亚马逊公司正在洽谈收购卫星提供商事宜后，Globalstar Inc. 股价在尾盘交易中上涨了 20% 以上。

title_zh: 华尔街收高，因对伊朗战争结束的猜测

title: Stock market today: Dow S&P 500, Nasdaq futures stumble after Trump says war with Iran not yet over
title_zh: 今日股市：特朗普表示与伊朗的战争尚未结束，道指标普 500 指数和纳斯达克期货下跌
summary: A national address from the president failed to calm markets as the Iran war dominates fiscal conversation.
summary_zh: 由于伊朗战争主导了财政对话，总统的全国讲话未能安抚市场。

title: Amazon eyes $9 billion Globalstar deal to rival SpaceX's Starlink, FT reports
title_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，亚马逊计划以 90 亿美元收购 Globalstar，以与 SpaceX 的 Starlink 竞争
summary: Amazon is in talks to buy satellite telecom group Globalstar as it ramps up efforts to build its own ‌low-earth-orbit satellite business to rival SpaceX's Starlink, the Financial Times reported ‌on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: 据英国《金融时报》周三援引知情人士的话报道，亚马逊正在就收购卫星电信集团 Globalstar 进行谈判，该公司正在加大力度建立自己的低地球轨道卫星业务，以与 SpaceX 的 Starlink 竞争。

title_zh: 苹果下一个 50 年的成功能否依靠人工智能和可折叠手机？

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq extend rally for 2nd day on hopes of Iran war deescalation
title_zh: 今日股市：道指、标普 500 指数和纳斯达克指数因伊朗战争降温的希望而延续第二天涨势
summary: Hope for equities is building as Iran and the US appear to be winding down aggressive rhetoric while markets seek stability.
summary_zh: 随着伊朗和美国似乎逐渐减少激进言论，同时市场寻求稳定，股市的希望正在增强。
